reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in embedding a frozen LLM directly into the symbolic regression loss function, transforming it from a post-hoc validation step into an active constraint. The LLM evaluates candidate equations based on dimensional consistency, simplicity, and physical realism, generating a scalar score c_LLM. This score is combined with traditional metrics (MSE, complexity) into a composite loss L = w1·MSE + w2·complexity + w3·c_LLM. The method addresses limitations of conventional SR where models may overfit to noise or produce physically meaningless expressions. By integrating domain knowledge via LLM prompting, the approach enables robust recovery of ground truth even under high noise conditions. The use of multiple LLMs and SR engines confirms generalizability. The novel tree distance metric further enhances expression comparison, supporting convergence analysis. This primitive bridges the gap between data-driven discovery and principled physical modeling.
